mlm:name: EarthPT
description: EarthPT is a 700 million parameter autoregressive decoding transformer foundation model for Earth Observation, trained on multispectral time series data to forecast future pixel-level surface reflectances and produce semantically meaningful embeddings for downstream tasks.
mlm:architecture: Autoregressive decoding transformer (Radford et al. 2019) with MLP input embedding
pretraining: Trained in an autoregressive self-supervised manner to predict the next observation in multispectral time series of surface reflectance.
domain_knowledge: Remote sensing indices (NDVI, NDWI, BSI, GCVI)
backbone_modifications: MLP input embedding for non-textual data
Additional float embeddings for date of current and next observation

mlm:input.name: Sentinel-1 (SAR, for input to ClearSky), Sentinel-2 (simulated via ClearSky)

mlm:pretrained_source: ClearSky inferred Sentinel-2 equivalent imagery (UK, TL BNG tile)
sampling: Time series sampled at Sentinel-1 cadence (~5 days); Time range: January 2015 to December 2022 (train/val), January 2023 to May 2023 (test)
processing:lineage: Float16 NumPy arrays; Spectral band normalization (v/500-1); Date embedding (sin/cos)
missing_data: ClearSky fills gaps using SAR, so no missing data due to clouds

mlm:hyperparameters.patch_size: Each temporal observation as a token; block size 256
mlm:hyperparameters.learning_rate: max 2E-5, decayed by factor of 10 over 1.1x total steps

benchmarks.application: Pixel-level surface reflectance and remote sensing index forecasting
benchmarks.dataset: ClearSky inferred Sentinel-2 equivalent imagery (UK, TL63 BNG tile)
